row.notes: Resolves the driver with Ent_Get_Driver_Thunk (static key 0x146068bd8, or when that is invalid 0x3fff the handle at (self+0x20 -> +0x238)+0x260 falling back to +0x1b0); returns if none. In a career mode (mode at (self+0x40)+0x88 -> +0x260) with the career component and 0x14077c7d0 true and not MyTeam, it finds the local player's entrant by identity and writes entrant+0x58 to request+0xa0 (valid byte +0xa4). Otherwise it finds the entrant whose +0x50 handle matches the driver and writes +0x50 to request+8, +0x54 to +0xe and +0x58 to +0xa0 with valid bytes +0xc/+0x12/+0xa4. If the registry string ui_menu_data.customisation.context has hash 0x980a1201 the static handle 0x146068bc4 (when valid) overrides request+0xa0. request+0x8a ends true only when no entrant was found. Callers Game_CustomisationVM_BuildSelectRequest, 0x14201bee0 and 0x142033230 (both build the same customisation request on the stack) call it just before sending the request.
